notes.title: Rally Mechanic Simulator: LIGHT EDITION – The Updated and Expanded Prologue
notes.content:
Hey Mechanics! 🔧

Over the past months, we’ve received tons of amazing feedback about the RMS Prologue. Many of you enjoyed it, but also pointed out that it lacked some of the features that make Rally Mechanic Simulator truly special. We heard you, and we agree!
That’s why we’re taking a big step forward:

Next week, we plan to eveolve the Prologue into [b]Rally Mechanic Simulator: LIGHT EDITION[/b] and it will remain 100% free.

This isn’t just a name change. It’s a full overhaul designed to bring the Prologue much closer to the full version of the game. We’re adding more content, more functionality, and features the community asked for - including the ability to save your game.

We want this to be a better entry point for new players, and a genuine thank-you to everyone who gave the Prologue a try. It’s our way of saying: we appreciate your support, and we want you to have fun even if you’re not ready to buy the full game yet.

[h3]🛠️ What’s coming in Rally Mechanic Simulator: LIGHT?[/h3]
Here’s what you’ll get in the upcoming update:

✅ The game can now be saved!
Yes - finally! You’ll be able to continue your work between sessions, just like in the full version.

✅ All updates and bug fixes from the full version
The LIGHT edition will be upgraded to the current stable build of RMS, including performance improvements, UI fixes, and core stability enhancements.

✅ 2 free rally cars unlocked: Pudro 276 and Sortes SC95T1
These two vehicles will be fully playable, letting you experience core systems like damage handling, part swapping, diagnostics, and driving.

✅ Full access to the Paint Shop
Customize your ride just like in the full game - from base colors to decal placement and liveries.

✅ Test Drive mode with latest improvements
Take your cars for a spin before hitting the stages to test handling, upgrades, and reliability.

✅ Updated failure system
Experience realistic part breakdowns that vary based on your repairs and rally conditions.

✅ Bronze League rally access (limited)
Try a selection of beginner rally events and see how your preparation and repairs hold up under pressure.

✅ New commentator voice lines
The improved commentator system brings more atmosphere and energy to your rally events.

✅ 2 garage slots
Keep and manage multiple cars at once - just like a real rally team would!

✅ Ability to purchase extra cars via low-cost DLCs
Want to grow your garage even more? Optional car DLCs let you expand your collection at your own pace.

[h3]🚫 What’s not included in LIGHT?[/h3]
To keep things balanced, some premium features will still be exclusive to the full version:
❌ No access to the Dyno
❌ No sponsorship contracts
❌ No internal tuning parts
But for a free version, we think it’s pretty packed with features! 

[h3]🏁 Why Go Full?[/h3]
The full version of Rally Mechanic Simulator offers:
[list]
[*] A full roster of vehicles
[*] Advanced diagnostics, tuning, and full car management systems
[*] Sponsorship contracts and career progression
[*] More tools, upgrades, and customization options
[*] Deeper rally content, new environments, and ongoing updates!
[/list]
We hope this change makes it easier and more fun for everyone to explore what RMS has to offer. Whether you're a newcomer, a curious player, or someone on the fence about upgrading, LIGHT EDITION is our way of making Rally Mechanic Simulator more accessible, transparent, and enjoyable for all. And if you’re loving your time in the LIGHT EDITION, upgrading is the best way to dive deeper into the world of rally mechanics.

More news soon as we roll out the update next week!

notes.title: Sponsorship Contracts Are Here! 🏁💰
notes.content:
Hey Mechanics! 🛠️

It’s time to take your rally career to the next level! [b]Sponsorship Contracts[/b] are now live in Rally Mechanic Simulator!

This new system brings extra challenges from sponsors, allowing you to earn additional rewards while competing in rallies. Your performance on the track will now have even greater stakes, as sponsors will expect you to meet their specific requirements to secure funding!

[h2]How does it work?[/h2]

🔹 Check Available Contracts – Open the Contracts tab on your laptop to browse available sponsorship deals. Each contract comes with different objectives and rewards, so choose wisely!

🔹 Monitor Your Progress – Keep track of your contract’s requirements to ensure you’re on track to complete them. Whether it’s parts-based goals, car condition or colour, sponsors will have their demands!

🔹 Cancel Contracts Anytime – If you decide a contract isn’t working out, you can cancel it anytime. Depending on your progress, you may still receive a partial payout instead of losing everything.

🔹 Complete & Get Paid! – Once you fulfill all the sponsor’s requirements, you can finalize the contract and claim your full reward. After that, you’re free to pick another deal and keep pushing your team to success!

This system adds a new layer of strategy to Rally Mechanic Simulator. Now, you’re not just fixing cars! You’re managing your career, making financial decisions, and working towards bigger rewards. Picking the right contracts at the right time can make a huge difference in your journey to the top!

Check out our video to see how it works! 👇
https://youtu.be/JsddjzWb5Ug

We’re always working on new features, improvements, and updates based on your feedback. Let us know what you think about Sponsorship Contracts and what else you'd love to see in the game!

notes.title: Rally Mechanic Simulator Prologue - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Mechanics![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/8529375916bbbdd9afc4e3653279683c0f83e56d.png[/img]

Today’s the day! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002090/Rally_Mechanic_Simulator_Prologue/][b]Rally Mechanic Simulator Prologue drifts onto Steam![/b][/url]

We knew that we had something good on our hands, after loads of playtesting and positive feedback we received from the demo. However, you, players, requested one crucial feature - [b]driving[/b]. The Prologue has it!

The features of the prologue include:
[list]
[*] 2 rallies, a tarmac and a gravel one,
[*] a timing clock that puts a challenging spin on the mechanical games’ formula,
[*] a car inspired by a 90s JDM rally legend,
[*] minigames that will make your gameplay more varied,
[*] and finally… a test drive mode!
[/list]
This is a great opportunity to not only tinker with your car but also to send it. You will have a track at your disposal, a pretty quick car and a public leaderboard. And we have a small competition for you:

[b]The people who manage to have their time in the top 5 by next Friday (19th of July) will be granted a Steam key for the full version of the game when it releases![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/d04c4c8f9d0773d6229beee7470cbeda1432970f.gif[/img]

If that didn’t scratch your motorsport your motorsport itch, then nothing will. Head [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002090/Rally_Mechanic_Simulator_Prologue/][b]here[/b][/url] and get the prologue, as it’s out NOW!

notes.title: RMS Prologue Coming Soon - Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Fellow Mechanics![/h1]

Big news is coming! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002090/Rally_Mechanic_Simulator_Prologue/]The prologue of Rally Mechanic Simulator has its Steam card up live now[/url]! It features two rallies to conquer, plenty of parts to tinker with and Sortes Vixa, a car inspired by the JDM rally legends of the 90s.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/76aa21cfd74c45c006c3d13648780e93d4d6c136.png[/img]

This may seem like a similar set of features to those we had in the demo. Of course, we also made loads of fixes and got rid of all the annoying bugs. However, the game’s demo was released a while ago. Before that, there were playtests. And we’ve encountered one request which we hadn’t had in our plans but made a lot of sense. [b]To have driving in the game.[/b]

[h2]We listened to you.
[/h2]

Rally Mechanic Simulator’s prologue will feature a [b]test drive mode[/b] with timed laps. We’ve been testing it with some community members for the last 2 weeks or so (join our [url=https://discord.gg/Grj6R3B]Discord server[/url] to become a part of the P2C community!) and we’ve all been having a blast while also making plenty of additional fixes. A cool thing is that changing parts does influence the way your car will drive, with gravel parts making the ride higher and softer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/d04c4c8f9d0773d6229beee7470cbeda1432970f.gif[/img]

Where will we go with the mode? We’ll see. However, keep in mind that it’s not going to be the core activity of the game and will not make RMS into a proper racing game.

We expect to release the prologue soon and will let you know once it’s up. In the meantime, give the demo a shot and pop into our Discord server to spend some quality time with other gearheads!

Wishlist the prologue here - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002090/Rally_Mechanic_Simulator_Prologue/]CLICK[/url].

notes.title: Sign up for the playtests!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/24432d60c0560f11428423d90c22634a3c7bb146.gif[/img]

As we’ve been saying for a short while, the [b]public playtests are almost here. We’ve opened signing up for them on our Steam product page, so [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588090/Rally_Mechanic_Simulator/]head there[/url] and click the "Request Access" button to take part[/b]!

Let’s quickly go through the features that will be present in the playtest:
[list]
[*] [b]Garage[/b]- will be where you’ll have access to parts, and fixing machines and you’ll be able to prepare your car for the rallies.
[*] [b]2 rallies[/b] - a tarmac one with a single stage and a gravel one with 2 stages.
[*] [b]Service park[/b] - a tent where you can fix your car during the rallies mentioned above.
[*] [b]A single car[/b] - inspired by a Japanese rally legend, sporting a 4-cylinder boxer engine.
[*] [b]“Live radio” commentary[/b] on the rally.
[*] [b]2 minigames[/b] - the stuff like tire balancing and putting tires on the rims is going to be represented by a fun and simple minigame.
[*] [b]Tutorial[/b] - just to make sure that you’ll be able to work on the car and take part in rallies.
[*] And, of course, [b]the possibility to tinker with your car![/b]
[/list]
This is going to be enough gameplay for about an hour and a half. This will definitely scratch your itch for some mechanical sim fun. Also, what’s important is that this is still a relatively early build and your purpose is to… Have at it! Aside from having a good time, we also want to get into every nook and cranny of RMS and try to flip it on its head. If you do, we’ll be able to make a more stable game overall and a better demo. 

We strongly encourage you to report all of the bugs and glitches that you find to our [url=https://discord.gg/atpUy3yqFM]Discord server[/url] or the Steam forum. We really want to make the game as polished as it gets and plenty of data will help us, that’s for sure.

[previewyoutube=MUGqX_Ntmp4;full][/previewyoutube]
Speaking of the demo…

The plans for the immediate future include introducing heaps of bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements to the main build of the game. We’ve also been working on a [b]demo which will be released for the upcoming Steam Next Fest[/b]. Hope you’ll like it! A couple of months after that, we aim to release Rally Mechanic Simulator in Early Access.

So, tl;dr

[b]Sign up for the upcoming Rally Mechanic Simulator playtests by clicking the “Request Access” button on the game’s Steam page.[/b]

Have a good one, cheers!

notes.title: 2023 Summary & Big Plans For 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Hello fellow mechanic!
[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/276303fb239f185f2497a88333825bdcbdde2165.gif[/img]

This year has been a wild ride for us. Rally Mechanic Simulator has taken a tangible form and you’ll soon be able to give it a shot during the upcoming playtests. However, it was a busy year for us - we’ve done so much work on the game, we were almost surprised when we were preparing the list of our accomplishments. We’ll present it below and, what’s more interesting, we’ll share our plans for the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/9d8527f0c202c9b0d8f13433dcb3eae128f5d94b.png[/img]

[h2]What was done this year[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Entire gameplay loop[/b] - choosing a rally, taking part in it, working in the garage.
[*] [b]Car upgrade system[/b].
[*] [b]In-game parts store[/b].
[*] [b]Car customization system[/b].
[*] [b]Bodywork damage system[/b].
[*] [b]The commentary system[/b] - you’ll hear it on the radio during the rallies.
[*] Introduction of parts and assets like [b]garage upgrades[/b] that will allow you to progress in the game.
[*] Plenty of other stuff.
[/list]

We’ve also made plenty of great art and assets, some of which you can have a look at now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/328978097ab95bf3d1c0b2b5455600ab66b29620.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/cbabe3ae14a40d455bfbf544b1e03c85043202f5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/dd4f35bed773fe9286fca692f5ea056120621d76.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/84b8c8410f30252121691d51ff60a9d2fe5328c7.gif[/img]

All of this is absolutely necessary for the game to be fun and work well. There are still quite a lot of things we need to make and milestones we have to reach. However, we’re able to say with confidence that this was a good year for the team and we’re close to three next big steps. Let’s talk about the future, then.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/9d8527f0c202c9b0d8f13433dcb3eae128f5d94b.png[/img]

[h2]2024 is going to be great![/h2]

There will be plenty of opportunities to give Rally Mechanic Simulator a shot in the upcoming few months. 

Firstly, there are the [b]upcoming playtests[/b]. We’re still working on the game, trying to polish it and to have it in the state we want it to be. The tests are of great importance to us, as we’d love you to enjoy the game and provide feedback regarding it - suggestions, bugs, ideas, and anything goes. The tests will most likely last for a fixed amount of time, so if you wanna give RMS a shot and share your thoughts on the game, you better not miss out on it! The tests will feature the garage and two rallies with a service park at your disposal. The rallies will differ from each other to show a substantial glimpse of what to expect from the game.

Secondly, we expect to [b]release a demo for the upcoming Steam Next Fest in February[/b]. It will not be time-limited like the test and will remain up indefinitely. It will definitely be a more extensive build of the game and we’re sure you’ll love it. You’ll be able to play in about 2 months! The demo will feature a couple of hours' worth of gameplay, so you’ll definitely scratch your itch until the next release… :) 

Thirdly, and this is the really big one, we’ll release the [b]Early Access version of Rally Mechanic Simulator around the middle of 2024![/b] You’ll be able to purchase and play the game, while we’ll be delivering and polishing more and more stuff. This will lead to a full release in the future. We really hope for your support from day one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/9d8527f0c202c9b0d8f13433dcb3eae128f5d94b.png[/img]

To finish it off, here’s a [b]statement from the dev team[/b]:
We’re extremely happy that we’re able to show you the effect of our hard work in the upcoming weeks and months. We really hope that you’ll take part in creating Rally Mechanic Simulator with us, so we ask you to share each piece of feedback, problem and suggestion you may have. Our ultimate goal is to create a game that will bring fun and joy to both you and us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/9d8527f0c202c9b0d8f13433dcb3eae128f5d94b.png[/img]

That’s all for this entry. So, 2023 was good. But 2024 is going to be absolutely massive for Rally Mechanic Simulator with the upcoming releases. Keep an eye out on our social media and Steam page to follow the upcoming releases. You can also join our Discord server and share your ideas on what to introduce to the game. Cheers!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there, Mechanics![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/287ea62b0a9b6630e759844ad52a26c0dda83888.png[/img]
Thanks for the cool reception of the last devlog. Today we would like to show you some more features we plan to introduce. Without further ado, check out what we are cooking up for you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/f531a9862d270772f18ed1a945a2d0dc33102abf.png[/img]
Well, one of the basic functions will be to see if the car starts at all. You will even be able to [b]hear the engine sound[/b] change as you walk around, maybe by heading to the back. (?) Oh, and our [b]dashboard [/b]will be pretty awesome too! Each car will have its [b]own interface[/b] where you can check out all the important parameters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/9c241107deeba51de9186bb2b8fe8317ff9990e8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/318f28134530afab6c357e7ff5942109e1a047cc.png[/img]
Now, let's talk about the parts. We've got a whole set of them for you to play with. During the game, you'll be able to put on or [b]take off[/b] parts in [b]bigger sets[/b] like the brake set, giving you an edge and saving some precious time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/541db00a51ff348b96225eb7c959fa87cf6dec2c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/318f28134530afab6c357e7ff5942109e1a047cc.png[/img]
And let's not forget about [b]customization[/b]. We want you to have a blast modifying your car. It's not just about the available parts; you can even [b]tweak [/b]and [b]modify [/b]the parts themselves. Adjust the suspension settings, change the toe in, height, hardness, and more. It's your ride, your way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/7edd74775bde8605982647775dbdd1c30177c560.gif[/img]

By the way of car parts - we still consistently pay attention to [b]detail[/b]. Take a look for yourself!!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/4274046c321e89e446e34c8375e6611d0a095dfd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/318f28134530afab6c357e7ff5942109e1a047cc.png[/img]
But here's the game changer—[b]the wiring system[/b]. We've gone all out in paying attention to this detail. It's not just about the electrical system, though. We've got [b]functioning piping and connections for fluids and air[/b]. It's all about creating a realistic experience! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/93df72df324d2a03ab40cf74d3f8b466c9ee781d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/f2f0cdc5d9de3e200d316bb61be289e8a31ee69c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/318f28134530afab6c357e7ff5942109e1a047cc.png[/img]

That's all for today, folks. We're diving back into work, so get ready to get your hands dirty.
We know that graphics and gifs won't give you the feeling of the game, so you can start getting ready for the demo. We will provide more info soon!!! Stay tuned!

And hey, if you want to chat, drop by our Discord and say hi. Give us a high five!
[url=https://discord.gg/Grj6R3B][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35097038/52776425f0640fde78df8f4963da1de04989d4ee.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
[h3]Hi Mechanics![/h3]

We are ready to start sharing information with you about our game. In the coming weeks, we will share some insight about different development parts. And the culmination will be [b]the demo[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/345988fd0f0449b7c0ba848240219c39ee92c9e9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/cc6376dd2a61fd58088852b334678a3a7652e9a9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/f2f7667f7e2509875ed2433b9420d1fa290a8a4c.png[/img]

For starters, we would like to show you the [b]car editing tool[/b]. With it, developers and modders will be able to configure cars and details in many ways. Below you can check out what the finished car looks like assembled in the modder tool. We are satisfied with the quality of the appearance, but we will certainly post a separate article about this on another occasion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/2ef10cfbd2e9b1d46d45eb1d5c6ecf15ef9a309c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/092119d31e5e6345b3bdda0b19e6582281207e02.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/f2f7667f7e2509875ed2433b9420d1fa290a8a4c.png[/img]
[i]Wiring work will be one of the features that sets our game apart.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/10408423247674e61e19bd0ec4b5b14b54f2d3a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/80cf6e38a3ca363ec80893925698bfa5bcc814d1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/f2f7667f7e2509875ed2433b9420d1fa290a8a4c.png[/img]
[i]One of the goals we set for ourselves at the beginning was to try to convey the true feeling of working on an engine.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/a1521a066cac692ff66cf4e9c2f3cb3e0334d37b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/5e45dd5e32a1ecaba87533ce3760bd12e8feddbf.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/f2f7667f7e2509875ed2433b9420d1fa290a8a4c.png[/img]
[i]Not everyone knows that the interiors of racing cars bear little resemblance to those of traditional vehicles. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/425defaa47e80bd88f9ae96355b907ac5e28e7f1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/b28f0c85ec6b0d60380b876f1946b0399b51169f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/f2f7667f7e2509875ed2433b9420d1fa290a8a4c.png[/img]
[i]We also pay very close attention to the materials of our car models. Here is an example of light propagation inside the lamp materia[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/8cd665511a432468024386e74309b7c135e514c7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/b77767ad1a502cc6765151f3b0ebb377fc0b0031.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40282246/f2f7667f7e2509875ed2433b9420d1fa290a8a4c.png[/img]
[i]We can't forget about a whole range of car parts, with which you will be able to customize, as well as affect engine power and other car performance.[/i]

That's it for today. We're back to work, and you can start getting ready because you're about to get dirty!


Feel free to drop by our discord and say hi. High five!

[url=https://discord.gg/Grj6R3B][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35097038/52776425f0640fde78df8f4963da1de04989d4ee.gif[/img][/url]
